entity.summary: Multichain Web3 wallet ecosystem distributed as mobile applications and browser wallet software.
entity.notes: Current first-party site establishes active MathWallet mobile/browser distribution. Reviewed security guidance treats mnemonic/private-key material as user-held secrets, but this candidate keeps custody_model unknown until a stronger current first-party custody statement is attached.

products.summary: Current MathWallet mobile wallet application for multichain Web3 use on iOS and Android.
products.notes: Selected mobile boundary only; browser wallet is deferred. Custody remains unknown pending stronger current first-party terms rather than being inferred from security guidance alone.

events.title: MathWallet v3.0.0 major update documented
events.description: MathWallet published its v3.0.0 project update, documenting major mobile-wallet changes including ChainX support, a redesigned cloud wallet, hardware-wallet integration, Binance DEX support, and strengthened cross-chain exchange functionality.

evidence.title: Math Wallet, The Multichain Wallet for Web3
evidence.notes: Current first-party site establishes active MathWallet mobile and browser wallet distribution across many public chains.

evidence.title: Security Guide of Math Wallet
evidence.notes: Official security guidance establishes user-held mnemonic/private-key backup workflows but does not by itself justify a stronger current provider-custody claim, so custody remains unknown.

evidence.title: MathWallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party MathWallet site distributes iPhone and Android builds and documents the multichain wallet product, supporting active maintenance.

evidence.title: Project Update | 2019.7.12
evidence.notes: First-party MathWallet project update documenting the v3.0.0 changes.
